responsibility: Implements the AVR target’s C-family frontend integration rather than RTL code generation. This file resolves overloaded AVR builtins such as the fixed-point generic functions, validates their argument counts and types, builds the corresponding builtin calls, and emits target-specific diagnostics for misuse; it also defines the AVR-specific predefined C macros that describe the selected core, device features, address spaces, builtin availability, fixed-point support, and configured double/long-double variants that the preprocessor exposes to user code.
